Definition: the mange (as making the hair fall off)
BiblicalUsage: çappachath means the mange. It appears twice, in Leviticus among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çappachath, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
